name: soia-vault-curator
description: Personal knowledge vault curator: archive web, WeChat, X and cloud-drive material into a local Markdown vault, organize it, and turn it into interpretations, decks, long images and reading plans.

displayDescription.en: Archives web, WeChat and cloud-drive material into a local Markdown vault, organizes it with metadata and topic backlinks, then turns it into interpretations, decks, long images and reading plans.
displayDescription.zh: 把网页、公众号与云盘资料收进本地知识库，按元数据与主题双链整理，再转成解读、演示稿与长图。

quickPrompts.en: My reading material is scattered across bookmarks, WeChat and cloud drives. Help me pull it into one local Markdown vault and keep it organized.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的资料散在收藏夹、公众号和云盘里，帮我收进一个本地 Markdown 知识库并持续整理好。

quickPrompts.en: Archive this article into my vault, then tell me whether it is worth reading closely.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇文章存进我的知识库，然后告诉我它值不值得细读。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this article into a deck and a long image.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇文章转成演示稿和长图。
